function.name: get_caller_profile
function.description: Check the registered passenger using trusted call metadata. No identity arguments are accepted.

function.name: find_location
function.description: Resolve departure or destination. Ask for town, postal code or street number when ambiguous. Return candidate IDs and preserve attribution. Read the chosen candidate name and address to the caller, ask if it is correct, and wait for a clear yes before confirm_location.

function.name: confirm_location
function.description: Retain a candidate only after the assistant said its name and the caller clearly agreed. The server checks the latest spoken turn in Vapi's conversation messages. A candidate ID belongs only to its slot and latest lookup.

function.name: search_rides
function.description: Search using both locations previously confirmed in this call. Interpret German relative dates in Europe/Vienna and clarify ambiguity. Send a future ISO datetime with its date's correct UTC offset and 1 to 8 seats. An empty suggestions array means no match and never permits automatic booking.

function.name: prepare_booking
function.description: Select a ride.id from the latest search suggestions. Speak the returned German summary exactly, then wait for a clear yes or no. Missing price is unknown. A trip or location change requires a fresh search, summary and agreement.

function.name: confirm_booking
function.description: Submit only after a clear spoken yes to the exact prepared summary. No means no booking; uncertainty and unrelated yes answers are rejected. Do not supply confirmed or identity arguments. After timeout retry this tool in the same call; the server reuses its saved action key. A successful request is pending driver approval. Do not prepare a new action to retry an uncertain submission.

function.name: get_booking_status
function.description: Read the current driver's decision. Use an actual booking ID, not a ride request ID, when available. Otherwise omit bookingId to list all caller bookings. A submission receipt does not establish current approval.
